# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 送死口中玉也。从玉从含，含亦聲。
石之似玉者。从玉言聲。
As per 求# (wrap) + 玉 jewel → pearl wrapped in an oyster shell → *round jewel*; *spherical object*; *ball*; *bulb* (compare 玉).
玉聲也。从玉求聲。
As per 良# (pure) + 玉 jewel → pure (whitish) jewel. A variant form, 瑯, replaces 良 with 郎. The compound 琺瑯 refers to enamel.
琅玕，似珠者。从玉良聲。
As per 里# (long strip) + 玉 jewel → veins or streaks in a piece of jade → *logic*; *reason* (← lines/threads of a reasoning process ← vein; streak) → *principle*; *natural science*.
治玉也。从玉里聲。

As per 㐬# as described in 流 (flow) + 玉 jewel → *jewel* with a slippery surface over which the fingers flow. The compound 琉璃 is an abbreviation of 吠吠瑠璃, a transliteration of the Sanskrit vaidurya (lapis lazuli).
玉爵也。夏曰琖，殷曰斚，周曰爵。从玉戔聲。或从皿。
瓊琚。从玉居聲。《詩》曰：“報之以瓊琚。”
As per the right-hand element# as described in 探 (deep) + 玉 jewel → precious gem excavated from deep in the earth → *rare jewel*; *treasure*.
寶也。从玉，深省聲。
石之似玉者。从玉隹聲。讀若維。
玉也。从玉典聲。
玉也。从玉叔聲。
玉 jewel + 豕# for the sound alone to simulate the sound of a jewel being struck repeatedly by a tool in being cut/polished → *polish*.
治玉也。从玉豖聲。
玉 jewel + 爭# for the sound alone to simulate the *sound produced by tinkling jewels* (compare 瑲).
玉聲也。从玉爭聲。

虎# tiger (→ pattern resembling tiger stripes and coloration) + 玉 jewel → jewel with a coloration and pattern resembling a tiger → *amber*. Also, by reinterpretation, a *jewel or utensil in the shape of a tiger*.
發兵瑞玉，爲虎文。从玉从虎，虎亦聲。《春秋傳》曰：“賜子家雙琥。”
As per 奇# (unusual) + 玉 jewel → *unusual jewel*; *unusual*.
As per 昆# (circular group) + 玉 jewel → circular cluster of *beautiful jewels*.
石之美者。从玉昆聲。《虞書》曰：“楊州貢瑤琨。”
As per 其# (square/rectangular) + 玉 jewel → beautiful, rectangular *jewel*.
佩刀上飾。天子以玉，諸矦以金。从玉奉聲。
宛# bend + 玉 jewel → curved (jade) *scepter*.
圭有琬者。从玉宛聲。
As per 宗# (link) + 玉 jewel → linked, *jeweled implement* (used on ritual or ceremonial occasions).
瑞玉。大八寸，似車釭。从玉宗聲。
As per 官# (wrap about/enclose) + 玉 jewel → tubular (= wrap-about shape) wind instrument/*flute* made of jade. Compare 管.
As per 炎# (consuming blaze) + 玉 jewel → gems/jewels of blazing brilliance → *brilliant/glittering gem(s)* → *gem*; *jewel*.
璧上起美色也。从玉炎聲。
治玉也。一曰石似玉。从玉周聲。
As per 非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 玉 jewel → *string of pierced pearls/precious stones*. The compound 珈琲, meaning coffee, is a transliteration of the Dutch Koffie.
珠五百枚也。从玉非聲。
As per 林# (encompass) + 玉 jewel → jeweled necklace strung about the neck → *jewel*; *tinkling of a string of jewels* (compare 玲 and 瓏).
美玉也。从玉林聲。

As per 今# (contain) + 玨 (玉 jewel in abbreviated form, and doubled), here a shape indicator suggesting the outline of a particular musical instrument → musical instrument in which the sound is enclosed within a sealed base → *koto* (Japanese harp/zither).
An abbreviated form of 琴 stringed instrument + 比# for the sound alone to simulate one sound produced by an ancient, lute-like instrument ( 琵琶).
琵琶，樂器。从珡比聲。
An abbreviated form of 琴 stringed instrument + 巴# for the sound alone to simulate one sound produced by an ancient, lute-like instrument ( 琵琶).
琵琶也。从珡巴聲。義當用枇杷。
As per 法# (cover) + 玉 jewel → cover/coat a precious object with *enamel*.
As per 軍# (circularity) + 玉 jewel → beautiful, round *gem*.
石之似玉者。从玉禹聲。
諸侯執圭朝天子，天子執玉以冒之，似犂冠。《周禮》曰：“天子執瑁四寸。”从玉、冒，冒亦聲。
石之似玉者。从玉眉聲。讀若眉。
璧六寸也。从玉宣聲。
黑石似玉者。从玉皆聲。讀若諧。
圭璧上起兆瑑也。从玉，篆省聲。《周禮》曰：“瑑圭璧。”
圭。尺二寸，有瓚，以祠宗廟者也。从玉昜聲。
As per 叚# (overlay) + 玉 jewel → *flaw/blemish* overlaying the surface of a jewel → *defect*; *mistake*; *fault*.
玉小赤也。从玉叚聲。
As per 爰# (twist about) + 玉 jewel → large, flat *jewel*, circular in shape and with a hollowed-out middle through which string would be run. Compare 鍰.
大孔璧。人君上除陛以相引。从玉爰聲。《爾雅》曰：“好倍肉謂之瑗，肉倍好謂之璧。”
As per 𡿺# as described in 惱 (brain) + 玉 jewel → jewel the color of a (horse's) brain → *agate*. Note a variant form, 碯, which appears in the compound 碼碯 (agate).
As per 胡# (rough, covering substance) + 玉 jewel → jewel-encrusted, ritual *food stand*. The compound 珊瑚 refers to coral.
珊瑚也。从玉胡聲。
英# brilliance + 玉 jewel → lustrous, *sparkling jewel(ry)*. Also, a *transparent jewel* (such as crystal or quartz).
玉光也。从玉英聲。
兪# remove + 玉 jewel → jewel with all flaws excised → *high-grade jewel* → *beautiful*.
瑾瑜，美玉也。从玉俞聲。
玉聲也。从玉皇聲。
As per 耑# (neatly aligned) + 玉 jewel → neatly aligned gems bestowed on an *auspicious* occasion → *congratulations*. *Fresh and lively* is a borrowed meaning.
以玉爲信也。从玉、耑。
An abbreviated form of 琴 stringed instrument + 必# for the sound alone to simulate a sound produced by a *(large) stringed instrument* → *large koto*.
庖犧所作弦樂也。从珡必聲。
玉 jewel + 留# for the sound alone to transliterate the middle syllable of the Sanskrit vaidurya (lapis lazuli: 吠瑠璃). Compare 琉. 璢 is a variant form.
As per the right-hand element# described in 鎖 (small shells, pierced and strung together) + 玉 jewel → *small* fragments (of jewels, linked in a chain) → *trifling*.
玉聲也。从玉𧴪聲。
玉之美者。从玉䍃聲。《詩》曰：“報之以瓊瑤。”
石之似玉者。从玉烏聲。
As per 𤇾# as described in 榮 (curve about) + 玉 jewel → *halo* given off by jewels → *clarity*. Also, a *stone as beautiful as a gem*.
玉色。从玉，熒省聲。一曰石之次玉者。《逸論語》曰：“如玉之瑩。”
馬# horse + 玉 jewel → precious stone the color of a horse's brain. The compound 瑪瑙 refers to agate/cornelian. Compare 碼.
垂玉也。冕飾。从玉流聲。
玉英華羅列秩秩。从玉㮚聲。《逸論語》曰：“玉粲之璱兮。其𤩰猛也。”
As per 鬼# (large and lumpy) + 玉 jewel → extraordinary, lump-shaped jewel → *conspicuous*.
玟瑰。从玉鬼聲。一曰圜好。
As per 眞# (fullness) + 玉 jewel → *jeweled earring* (that fills the hole of a pierced ear).
以玉充耳也。从玉眞聲。《詩》曰：“玉之瑱兮。”
玉 jewel + 倉# for the sound alone to simulate the *sound produced by tinkling jewels* (compare 琤).
玉聲也。从玉倉聲。《詩》曰：“鞗革有瑲。”
As per 差# (irregular) + 玉 jewel → *polish* a jewel to remove irregularities and render it lustrous. Compare 磋.
玉色鮮白。从玉差聲。
車蓋玉瑵。从玉蚤聲。
As per 䍃# as described in 搖 (waver) + 玉 jewel → shimmering/wavering light reflected by a *beautiful jewel* → *beautiful*. Note a variant form 瑤.
As per 𦰩# as described in 漢 (minute) + 玉 jewel → *jewel*, reduced in size but rendered beautiful by cutting and polishing.
瑾瑜，美玉也。从玉堇聲。
璀璨，玉光也。从玉崔聲。
石之似玉者。从玉悤聲。讀若蔥。
玉 jewel + 离# for the sound alone to transliterate the final syllable of the Sanskrit vaidurya (lapis lazuli: 吠瑠璃). The compound 玻璃 refers to crystal and/or glass.缽 (11)　ハチ；ハツ　 Shinjitai
石之似玉者。从玉巢聲。
As per 翏# (separate from a main unit) + 玉 jewel → round *jewel* (compare 球), a series of which were fitted separately in an ancient percussion instrument (compare 磬).
旋# rotate + 玉 jewel → rotate a (beautiful) *jewel*. Also, a *star* in the Northern Dipper (constellation Ursa Major).
玉䞓色也。从玉㒼聲。禾之赤苗謂之虋，言璊，玉色如之。
As per 章# (rise) + 玉 jewel → *jeweled implement* (of an oblong shape) held high on ceremonial occasions.
剡上爲圭，半圭爲璋。从玉章聲。《禮》：六幣：圭以馬，璋以皮，璧以帛，琮以錦，琥以繡，璜以黼。
劍鼻玉也。从玉彘聲。
玉也。从玉路聲。
三采玉也。从玉無聲。
石之似玉者。从玉登聲。
石之次玉者。从玉莠聲。《詩》曰：“充耳璓瑩。”
金之美者。與玉同色。从玉湯聲。《禮》：“佩刀，諸矦璗琫而璆珌。”
As per 粦# as described in 隣 (repeated series) + 玉 jewel → repeated pattern on a jewel → *luster* given off by a jewel.
玉也。从玉尞聲。

As per 黃# (extend) + 玉 jewel → light reflected from a jewel and extending a great distance (a meaning retained in the compound 璜璜). However, 璜 came also to refer to a particular type of *jeweled ornament* used as a waistband accessory, specifically, a disk-shaped precious stone ( 璧) cut in half.
半璧也。从玉黃聲。
As per 菐# as described in 僕 (rough) + 玉 jewel → (as yet uncut or unpolished) *gem*. Compare 玫.
璵璠。魯之寶玉。从玉番聲。孔子曰：“美哉璵璠。遠而望之，奐若也；近而視之，瑟若也。一則理勝，二則孚勝。”
石之似玉者。从玉進聲。讀若津。
幾# minute + 玉 jewel → *pearl that is not completely round* (← minute imperfection).
珠不圜也。从玉幾聲。
玉也。从玉敬聲。
As per 辟# (spread) + 玉 jewel → spreading, *disk-shaped precious stone* (with a hole in the middle).
瑞玉圜也。从玉辟聲。
玉光也。从玉粲聲。
環屬。从玉豦聲。見《山海經》。
玉飾。如水藻之文。从玉喿聲。《虞書》曰：“璪火黺米。”
As per 當# (fit together) + 玉 jewel → *jeweled ornament* suspended from a crown, and covering the ear → *earring*. Compare 黈.
華飾也。从玉當聲。
玉佩。从玉敫聲。

睘# was originally 袁 (wrap about/enclose) + 目 eye → all-encompassing observation (compare 觀). In derivative characters, the "all-encompassing" aspect of 睘 takes the aspect "circularity." 環 adds 玉 jewel → jeweled *ring*/bracelet → *circle*; *surround*. *Return* is a borrowed meaning via 還. For "ring," compare 鐶; for "bracelet," compare 釧.
璧也。肉好若一謂之環。从玉睘聲。
玉英華相帶如瑟弦。从玉瑟聲。《詩》曰：“瑟彼玉瓚。”
璵璠也。从玉與聲。
石之似玉者。从玉盡聲。
玉器也。从玉𠷎聲。讀若淑。
爾# seal + 玉 jewel → *imperial seal*. 璽 was devised to replace 爾 after 爾 acquired its borrowed meanings.
美玉也。从玉睿聲。《春秋傳》曰：“璿弁玉纓。”
玉器也。从玉畾聲。
玓瓅。从玉樂聲。
赤玉也。从玉敻聲。
As per 龍# (winding) + 玉 jewel → the *clean/clear tinkling sound made by a long chain of jewels* (compare 玲 and 琳). 瓏 has also been understood as a *jewel cut into the form of a dragon*.
禱旱玉。龍文。从玉从龍，龍亦聲。
As per 嬰# (necklace) + 玉 jewel → *necklace*. 瓔 was devised to replace 嬰 after 嬰 acquired its borrowed meanings.
弛弓也。从弓璽聲。
玉也。从玉雚聲。《春秋傳》曰：“瓘斚。”
As per 贊# (accumulate in small increments) + 玉 jewel → *goblet* decorated with an accumulation of small gems.
三玉二石也。从玉贊聲。《禮》：“天子用全，純玉也；上公用駹，四玉一石；侯用瓚；伯用埒，玉石半相埒也。”
桓圭。公所執。从玉獻聲。
A depiction of a *melon* (conceptualized as a solitary object pendent on a vine) → *gourd*.
㼌也。象形。凡瓜之屬皆从瓜。
㼎也。从瓜失聲。《詩》曰：“緜緜瓜瓞。”
As per 夸# (U-shaped) + 瓜 pendent, oval-shaped melon/gourd → (U-shaped) *gourd* (compare 匏); (gourd-shaped) *pot*.
匏也。从瓜夸聲。凡瓠之屬皆从瓠。
As per 票# (light) + 瓜 pendent, oval-shaped melon/gourd → dried *gourd* made into a lightweight ladle. Compare 匏.
蠡也。从瓠省，㶾聲。
As per 辡# as described in 弁 (split) + 瓜 pendent, oval-shaped melon/gourd → *petal* resembling a melon/gourd split into symmetrical halves → *seed* → *valve* (← resemblance of shape).
瓜中實。从瓜辡聲。
A depiction of two overlapping tiles, forming a round shape → *tile* → *unglazed earthenware*. *Gram* is a borrowed meaning.
土器已燒之總名。象形。凡瓦之屬皆从瓦。
瓦 here an abbreviation for the phonetic construction 瓦蘭姆 (gram) + 十 ten → *one decagram* (= 10 grams).
似罌，長頸。受十升。讀若洪。从瓦工聲。
瓦 here an abbreviation for the phonetic construction 瓦蘭姆 (gram) + 千 one thousand → *one kilogram* (= 1,000 grams).
敗也。从瓦反聲。
周家搏埴之工也。从瓦方聲。讀若㧚破之㧚。
公# open + 瓦 tile/earthenware → large, wide-mouthed *jug/cistern* (compare 缸 and 甕).
罌也。从瓦公聲。

瓦 here an abbreviation for the phonetic construction 瓦蘭姆 (gram) + 分. In the 尺貫法 （シャッカンホウ） measuring system Japan inherited from China 分 represented 1/10 of a unit, so the combination of elements here creates the meaning *one decigram*.

瓦 here an abbreviation for the phonetic construction 瓦蘭姆 (gram) + 毛. In the 尺貫法 （シャッカンホウ） measuring system Japan inherited from China 毫 (often abbreviated as 毛) represented 1/1000 of a unit, so the combination of elements here creates the meaning *one milligram* (= 0.001 gram).
瓦 here an abbreviation for the phonetic construction 瓦蘭姆 (gram) + 屯 for the pronunciation トン to simulate "ton" → *one ton* (= 1,000 kilograms).

As per 令# (long sequence) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → series of concave tiles placed in sequence to channel water → *tile*. *Long-necked, handled earthenware pot* is via reinterpretation of the constituent elements of the character.
瓮，似瓶也。从瓦令聲。
甌瓿謂之瓵。从瓦台聲。
As per 次# (align) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → enamel aligned on the surface of earthenware → *high-quality chinaware*. For chinaware (porcelain), compare 磁.
瓦器。从瓦次聲。
瓦 here an abbreviation for the phonetic construction 瓦蘭姆 (gram) + 百 one hundred → *one hectogram* (= 100grams).
酒器。从瓦，稀省聲。
大盆也。从瓦尚聲。
As per 咅# (spread → bulge) + 瓦 tile/earthenware → small earthenware *pot/jar* with a bulging middle.
甂也。从瓦咅聲。
